Como funciona, em resumo:

  • substitutions no topo centraliza o que você troca: nome do dispositivo, entidades do HA (weather, fan, climate), cidade e fuso — sem procurar no meio do arquivo.
  • display (driver mipi_spi, modelo JC3248W535) + touchscreen (axs15231) ativam a tela e o toque; lvgl desenha a interface em 3 páginas com barra inferior.
  • Sensores platform: homeassistant puxam dados do HA (temperatura do clima, modo do ar, velocidade do ventilador) e atualizam os rótulos; os botões chamam serviços de volta (homeassistant.action) para abrir/fechar cortinas, ligar o ar e mudar a velocidade.
  • O relógio e a data são gerados localmente (via sntp), sem depender do HA.
  • Hardware: confirme a flash/PSRAM da sua unidade; se o boot falhar, teste psram.mode: quad. A rotação da tela pode precisar de 90°/270°.

Ajuste as substitutions para as suas entidades e valide no ESPHome Device Builder antes de gravar.

Exemplo pronto: tela Thread com temperatura e umidade (Waveshare C6-GEEK)#

A placa Waveshare ESP32-C6-GEEK junta três coisas num dispositivo só: conexão Thread, uma telinha ST7789V (240×135) e um sensor DHT (AM2302/DHT11) de temperatura e umidade. A tela mostra relógio, data e as leituras do sensor, enquanto o dispositivo entra na sua rede Thread.

Dado MUITO sensível. O campo tlv (o dataset) do Thread contém a chave da sua rede — nunca o publique. A chave da API também é um exemplo; gere a sua.

# Waveshare ESP32-C6-GEEK: dispositivo Thread com tela ST7789V e sensor DHT.
# Troque a chave da API e, principalmente, o dataset TLV da sua rede Thread.

esphome:
  name: waveshare-esp32-c6-geek
  friendly_name: "Waveshare ESP32-C6-GEEK"
  min_version: 2026.9.0

esp32:
  board: esp32-c6-devkitc-1
  variant: esp32c6
  flash_size: 16MB
  framework:
    type: esp-idf
    version: recommended
    sdkconfig_options:
      CONFIG_ESP_TASK_WDT_TIMEOUT_S: "60"   # watchdog maior p/ FTD (init pode demorar)
      CONFIG_PM_ENABLE: "n"
      CONFIG_ESP_INT_WDT_TIMEOUT_MS: "2000"

logger:
  level: DEBUG

api:
  encryption:
    key: !secret api_encryption_key   # gere a sua no ESPHome Builder
  # Mantém a tela funcionando mesmo sem conexão com o HA.
  reboot_timeout: 0s

ota:
  - platform: esphome
    encryption:

# Thread usa IPv6.
network:
  enable_ipv6: true

# Rádio Thread. ATENÇÃO: o 'tlv' (dataset) contém a CHAVE DA SUA REDE THREAD.
# Nunca publique o seu; cole o dataset da sua rede aqui.
openthread:
  device_type: FTD
  force_dataset: true
  tlv: "COLE_AQUI_O_DATASET_TLV_DA_SUA_REDE_THREAD"
  output_power: 20dBm

# Horário do Google, exibido no fuso de Fortaleza.
time:
  - platform: sntp
    id: horario_google
    timezone: America/Fortaleza
    servers:
      - time1.google.com
      - time2.google.com
      - time3.google.com
    update_interval: 1h

spi:
  clk_pin: GPIO1
  mosi_pin: GPIO2

# As fontes são baixadas durante a preparação do firmware.
font:
  - file: "gfonts://Roboto"
    id: fonte_pequena
    size: 14

  - file: "gfonts://Roboto"
    id: fonte_valores
    size: 26
    glyphs: ["0123456789 .-°C%"]

  - file: "gfonts://Roboto"
    id: fonte_relogio
    size: 28

sensor:
  - platform: dht
    id: sensor_dht_1
    pin: GPIO11
    model: AM2302
    update_interval: 10s
    temperature:
      name: Temperature
      id: sensor_dht_1_temperature
      icon: "mdi:thermometer"
      accuracy_decimals: 0
    humidity:
      name: Humidity
      id: sensor_dht_1_humidity
      icon: "mdi:water-percent"
      accuracy_decimals: 0

  - platform: uptime
    name: "Waveshare ESP32-C6-GEEK Tempo de Atividade"
    id: uptime_sensor
    update_interval: 60s
    filters:
      - lambda: return x / 60.0;
    unit_of_measurement: "min"
    icon: mdi:clock-outline

display:
  - platform: st7789v
    id: tela
    model: CUSTOM
    cs_pin: GPIO5
    dc_pin: GPIO3
    reset_pin: GPIO4
    backlight_pin: GPIO6
    # Geometria nativa; a rotação resulta em 240 × 135.
    width: 135
    height: 240
    offset_width: 52
    offset_height: 40
    rotation: 270
    update_interval: 1s
    lambda: |-
      const Color branco(255, 255, 255);
      const Color cinza(160, 160, 160);
      const Color azul(80, 190, 255);
      const Color laranja(255, 180, 70);

      it.fill(Color(0, 0, 0));

      // Hora e data.
      auto agora = id(horario_google).now();

      if (agora.is_valid()) {
        it.strftime(
          120, 0, id(fonte_relogio), branco,
          TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "%H:%M:%S", agora
        );
        it.strftime(
          120, 34, id(fonte_pequena), cinza,
          TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", agora
        );
      } else {
        it.print(
          120, 0, id(fonte_relogio), branco,
          TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "--:--:--"
        );
        it.print(
          120, 34, id(fonte_pequena), cinza,
          TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "Sincronizando hora..."
        );
      }

      // Separadores e títulos.
      it.line(8, 57, 231, 57, cinza);
      it.line(120, 67, 120, 125, cinza);

      it.print(
        60, 65, id(fonte_pequena), cinza,
        TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "Temperatura"
      );
      it.print(
        180, 65, id(fonte_pequena), cinza,
        TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "Umidade"
      );

      // Leituras do DHT.
      const float temperatura =
        id(sensor_dht_1_temperature).state;
      const float umidade =
        id(sensor_dht_1_humidity).state;

      if (!isnan(temperatura)) {
        it.printf(
          60, 88, id(fonte_valores), laranja,
          TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "%.0f °C", temperatura
        );
      } else {
        it.print(
          60, 88, id(fonte_valores), laranja,
          TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "-- °C"
        );
      }

      if (!isnan(umidade)) {
        it.printf(
          180, 88, id(fonte_valores), azul,
          TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "%.0f %%", umidade
        );
      } else {
        it.print(
          180, 88, id(fonte_valores), azul,
          TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "-- %"
        );
      }

switch:
  - platform: restart
    id: restart_switch
    name: "Waveshare ESP32-C6-GEEK Restart Switch"

binary_sensor:
  - platform: status
    name: "Waveshare ESP32-C6-GEEK Status de Conexão"
    id: status_conexao

text_sensor:
  - platform: openthread_info
    ip_address:
      name: "Thread IP Address"
    channel:
      name: "Thread Channel"
    role:
      name: "Thread Device Role"
    rloc16:
      name: "Thread RLOC16"
    ext_addr:
      name: "Thread Extended Address"
    eui64:
      name: "Thread EUI64"
    network_name:
      name: "Thread Network Name"
    network_key:
      name: "Thread Network Key"
    pan_id:
      name: "Thread PAN ID"
    ext_pan_id:
      name: "Thread Extended PAN ID"

Como funciona, em resumo:

  • openthread (FTD) conecta a placa à rede Thread; o tlv é o dataset sigiloso (contém a chave da rede). O network: enable_ipv6 é obrigatório.
  • Um sensor DHT no GPIO11 lê temperatura e umidade a cada 10 s.
  • O display ST7789V desenha, no lambda, o relógio (via sntp), a data e as duas leituras — tudo localmente, sem depender do HA para a tela (reboot_timeout: 0s mantém a tela viva mesmo sem o HA).
  • Sensores de diagnóstico (uptime, status, dados do Thread) ajudam a monitorar.

Confira o sensor e a pinagem da sua placa, e valide no ESPHome Device Builder antes de gravar.

Exemplo de referência: painel de parede 7" para a casa toda (Waveshare 7B)#

Um painel de parede de 7" (Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-7B, 1024×600) que vira o controle central da casa: mostra relógio, clima com previsão de 5 dias, cotação do Bitcoin (com mini-gráfico) e uma página por cômodo com luzes (liga/desliga + brilho), ar-condicionado, ventilador e cortinas — tudo via Home Assistant, com LVGL v9.

Por ser grande e depender de arquivos próprios, vai aqui como referência comentada (trechos-chave), não o arquivo inteiro.

Este exemplo NÃO é autossuficiente. Ele precisa acompanhar: - waveshare_7b/panel_data.h — um header C++ com a lógica do Bitcoin (parsing da Coinbase, mini-gráfico) e a função condition_pt(), que traduz as condições do clima; - as imagens dos cômodos (waveshare_7b/assets/*.jpg).

Requer ESPHome 2026.9+ e, no HA, a opção "Permitir que o dispositivo realize ações do Home Assistant" ativada. A chave da API e o IP fixo são apenas exemplos — gere/ajuste os seus.

1. Base (placa, PSRAM, API e Wi-Fi):

substitutions:
  name: waveshare-esp32-s3-touch-lcd-7b
  friendly_name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-7B
  weather_entity: weather.home

esphome:
  name: ${name}
  friendly_name: ${friendly_name}
  min_version: 2026.9.0
  includes:
    - waveshare_7b/panel_data.h   # header C++ (lógica do Bitcoin, condition_pt) — precisa acompanhar
  on_boot:
    - priority: -100
      then:
        - light.turn_on: { id: screen_backlight, brightness: 75% }
        - script.execute: refresh_clock
        - delay: 8s
        - script.execute: fetch_market
        - script.execute: fetch_forecast

esp32:
  board: esp32-s3-devkitc-1
  variant: esp32s3
  flash_size: 16MB
  framework:
    type: esp-idf

psram:
  mode: octal
  speed: 80MHz

api:
  encryption:
    key: !secret api_encryption_key   # gere a sua no ESPHome Builder
  reboot_timeout: 0s                   # mantém a tela viva mesmo sem o HA

wifi:
  ssid: !secret wifi_ssid
  password: !secret wifi_password
  # manual_ip opcional — ajuste à sua rede ou remova para usar DHCP

2. Tela RGB + toque (a parte mais sensível do hardware):

# Tela RGB 1024x600 (driver nativo mipi_rgb) + toque GT911 no barramento I2C.
# Um expansor I2C (waveshare_io_ch32v003) controla reset/enable/backlight.
display:
  - platform: mipi_rgb
    id: disp1
    model: RPI
    dimensions: { width: 1024, height: 600 }
    color_order: RGB
    pclk_frequency: 30MHz
    pclk_inverted: true
    # pinos de dados e sincronismo conforme a placa (ver config completa)
    update_interval: never
    auto_clear_enabled: false

touchscreen:
  - platform: gt911
    id: touch_panel
    display: disp1
    i2c_id: touch_bus
    address: 93

3. Cotação do Bitcoin (requisição HTTP à Coinbase, sem depender do HA):

http_request:
  id: market_http
  verify_ssl: true

script:
  - id: fetch_market
    then:
      - http_request.get:
          url: https://api.exchange.coinbase.com/products/BTC-USD/ticker
          capture_response: true
          on_response:
            - lambda: |-
                waveshare_panel::bitcoin().parse_quote(body, id(panel_time).now().strftime("%H:%M"));
            - script.execute: refresh_bitcoin

4. Padrão de controle por entidade (repetido para cada luz/cômodo):

# Um sensor lê o brilho da luz no HA e move o slider da tela:
sensor:
  - platform: homeassistant
    id: level_light_led_sala
    entity_id: light.led_sala
    attribute: brightness
    on_value:
      - lvgl.slider.update:
          id: slider_light_led_sala
          value: !lambda "return std::isfinite(x) ? (int)lroundf(x * 100.0f / 255.0f) : 0;"

# E, dentro da página do cômodo, o botão/slider chama o serviço de volta:
#   button (toggle) + slider (brilho) -> homeassistant.action: light.toggle / light.turn_on

Como funciona, em resumo:

  • A tela usa o driver nativo mipi_rgb (1024×600) e o toque gt911; um expansor I²C (waveshare_io_ch32v003) cuida de reset, enable e backlight.
  • Dezenas de sensores platform: homeassistant espelham o estado das entidades (brilho, modo do ar, estado das cortinas) e atualizam os widgets LVGL; os botões e sliders chamam serviços de volta com homeassistant.action.
  • O relógio, a previsão (via weather.get_forecasts do HA) e o Bitcoin (API da Coinbase) são atualizados por interval/script.
  • A interface tem uma página principal (clima + BTC + atalhos por cômodo) e uma página por cômodo, com rolagem.

Trate este exemplo como um ponto de partida avançado: o arquivo completo (com panel_data.h e as imagens) é extenso e específico da casa.

Exemplo pronto: assistente de voz com tela (M5Stack AtomS3R + Echo Base)#

Um assistente de voz com telinha de status, feito com o M5Stack AtomS3R + Echo Base. Ele detecta palavras de ativação (Okay Nabu, Hey Jarvis, Hey Mycroft) com wake word no próprio dispositivo (ou pelo Home Assistant) e conversa com o Assist do HA; a tela mostra cada fase — ouvindo, pensando, respondendo — com as ilustrações do Casita.

Troque pelos seus dados antes de gravar. A chave da API e o IP fixo são exemplos; gere/ajuste os seus. As ilustrações, sons e modelos de wake word são baixados de URLs públicas durante a compilação — este exemplo não precisa de arquivos locais. Requer ESPHome 2026.7+ e o hardware de áudio do Echo Base (microfone + alto-falante).

substitutions:
  name: atom-lcd-echo
  friendly_name: "ATOM LCD ECHO"

  # Imagens do Casita
  loading_illustration_file: https://github.com/esphome/wake-word-voice-assistants/raw/main/casita/loading_320_240.png
  idle_illustration_file: https://github.com/esphome/wake-word-voice-assistants/raw/main/casita/idle_320_240.png
  listening_illustration_file: https://github.com/esphome/wake-word-voice-assistants/raw/main/casita/listening_320_240.png
  thinking_illustration_file: https://github.com/esphome/wake-word-voice-assistants/raw/main/casita/thinking_320_240.png
  replying_illustration_file: https://github.com/esphome/wake-word-voice-assistants/raw/main/casita/replying_320_240.png
  error_illustration_file: https://github.com/esphome/wake-word-voice-assistants/raw/main/casita/error_320_240.png
  error_no_wifi_illustration_file: https://github.com/esphome/wake-word-voice-assistants/raw/main/error_box_illustrations/error-no-wifi.png
  error_no_ha_illustration_file: https://github.com/esphome/wake-word-voice-assistants/raw/main/error_box_illustrations/error-no-ha.png

  # Fontes
  mdi_webfont_file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Templarian/MaterialDesign-Webfont/master/fonts/materialdesignicons-webfont.ttf

  # Arquivos de áudio
  wake_word_trigger_sound_file: https://github.com/esphome/home-assistant-voice-pe/raw/dev/sounds/wake_word_triggered.flac
  timer_finished_sound_file: https://github.com/esphome/home-assistant-voice-pe/raw/dev/sounds/timer_finished.flac
  error_cloud_expired_file: https://github.com/esphome/home-assistant-voice-pe/raw/dev/sounds/error_cloud_expired.mp3

  # Modelos Micro Wake Word
  stop_model_file: https://github.com/kahrendt/microWakeWord/releases/download/stop/stop.json

  # Cores de fundo
  loading_illustration_background_color: "000000"
  idle_illustration_background_color: "000000"
  listening_illustration_background_color: "FFFFFF"
  thinking_illustration_background_color: "FFFFFF"
  replying_illustration_background_color: "FFFFFF"
  error_illustration_background_color: "000000"

  # Fases do assistente de voz
  voice_assist_idle_phase_id: "1"
  voice_assist_listening_phase_id: "2"
  voice_assist_thinking_phase_id: "3"
  voice_assist_replying_phase_id: "4"
  voice_assist_not_ready_phase_id: "10"
  voice_assist_error_phase_id: "11"
  voice_assist_muted_phase_id: "12"
  voice_assist_timer_finished_phase_id: "20"

esphome:
  name: ${name}
  friendly_name: ${friendly_name}
  min_version: 2026.7.0
  on_boot:
    priority: 200
    then:
      - light.turn_on:
          id: lcd_backlight
          brightness: 100%
      - delay: 500ms
      - component.update: atoms3r_lcd
      - script.execute: draw_display
      - delay: 30s
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: return id(init_in_progress);
          then:
            - lambda: id(init_in_progress) = false;
            - script.execute: draw_display

esp32:
  variant: ESP32S3
  board: esp32-s3-devkitc-1
  flash_size: 8MB
  cpu_frequency: 240MHz
  framework:
    type: esp-idf
    sdkconfig_options:
      CONFIG_ESP32S3_DEFAULT_CPU_FREQ_240: "y"
      CONFIG_ESP32S3_DATA_CACHE_64KB: "y"
      CONFIG_ESP32S3_DATA_CACHE_LINE_64B: "y"

psram:
  mode: octal
  speed: 80MHz

api:
  encryption:
    key: !secret api_encryption_key   # gere a sua no ESPHome Builder
  on_client_connected:
    - script.execute: draw_display
  on_client_disconnected:
    - script.execute: draw_display

ota:
  - platform: esphome
    id: ota_esphome
    encryption:

wifi:
  ssid: !secret wifi_ssid
  password: !secret wifi_password
  manual_ip:                    # ajuste à sua rede ou remova para DHCP
    static_ip: 192.168.1.60
    gateway: 192.168.1.1
    subnet: 255.255.255.0
    dns1: 8.8.8.8
    dns2: 8.8.4.4
  power_save_mode: NONE
  on_connect:
    - script.execute: draw_display
  on_disconnect:
    then:
      - script.execute: draw_display
logger:
  level: DEBUG
  hardware_uart: USB_SERIAL_JTAG

button:
  - platform: factory_reset
    id: factory_reset_btn
    internal: true

  - platform: template
    name: "Testar alto-falante"
    entity_category: diagnostic
    on_press:
      - switch.turn_on: speaker_enable
      - script.execute:
          id: play_sound
          priority: true
          sound_file: !lambda return id(wake_word_triggered_sound);

binary_sensor:
  - platform: gpio
    pin:
      number: GPIO41
      mode: INPUT_PULLUP
      inverted: true
    id: user_button
    internal: true
    on_multi_click:
      # Clique rápido alterna o mudo
      - timing:
          - ON for at least 50ms
          - OFF for at least 50ms
        then:
          - switch.toggle: mute
          - switch.turn_off: timer_ringing

      # Pressionar por 10 segundos restaura os padrões de fábrica
      - timing:
          - ON for at least 10s
        then:
          - button.press: factory_reset_btn

external_components:
  - source: github://m5stack/esphome-yaml/components@main
    components:
      - lp5562
      - es8311
    refresh: 1d

i2c:
  - id: bsp_bus
    sda:
      number: GPIO45
      ignore_strapping_warning: true
    scl:
      number: GPIO0
      ignore_strapping_warning: true
    scan: true

  - id: ext_bus
    sda: GPIO38
    scl: GPIO39
    scan: true

pi4ioe5v6408:
  - id: pi4ioe5v6408_hub
    i2c_id: ext_bus
    address: 0x43

i2s_audio:
  - id: i2s_audio_bus
    i2s_lrclk_pin: GPIO6
    i2s_bclk_pin: GPIO8

spi:
  id: spi_bus
  clk_pin: GPIO15
  mosi_pin: GPIO21

audio_dac:
  - platform: es8311
    id: es8311_dac
    i2c_id: ext_bus
    bits_per_sample: 16bit
    sample_rate: 48000
    use_microphone: false
    use_mclk: false

microphone:
  - platform: i2s_audio
    id: i2s_mic
    sample_rate: 16000
    i2s_din_pin: GPIO7
    bits_per_sample: 16bit
    adc_type: external

speaker:
  - platform: i2s_audio
    id: i2s_speaker
    i2s_dout_pin: GPIO5
    dac_type: external
    sample_rate: 48000
    audio_dac: es8311_dac
    channel: left

media_player:
  - platform: speaker
    name: "Echo Base Player"
    id: echo_base_player
    volume_min: 0.5
    volume_max: 0.8

    announcement_pipeline:
      speaker: i2s_speaker
      format: FLAC
      sample_rate: 48000
      num_channels: 1

    files:
      - id: wake_word_triggered_sound
        file: ${wake_word_trigger_sound_file}

      - id: timer_finished_sound
        file: ${timer_finished_sound_file}

      - id: error_cloud_expired
        file: ${error_cloud_expired_file}

    on_state:
      - logger.log: "Estado do media player atualizado"

    on_play:
      - logger.log: "Reprodução iniciada"

    on_announcement:
      then:
        - logger.log:
            format: "Reproduzindo anúncio"
            level: DEBUG

        - if:
            condition:
              microphone.is_capturing:
            then:
              - script.execute: stop_wake_word

              - if:
                  condition:
                    lambda: |-
                      return id(wake_word_engine_location).current_option() ==
                             "In Home Assistant";
                  then:
                    - wait_until:
                        not:
                          voice_assistant.is_running:

        - if:
            condition:
              not:
                voice_assistant.is_running:
            then:
              - lambda: |-
                  id(voice_assistant_phase) =
                    ${voice_assist_muted_phase_id};
              - script.execute: draw_display

    on_idle:
      - if:
          condition:
            not:
              voice_assistant.is_running:
          then:
            - script.execute: start_wake_word
            - script.execute: set_idle_or_mute_phase
            - script.execute: draw_display

switch:
  # Habilitação do amplificador NS4150B
  - platform: gpio
    name: "Speaker Enable"
    id: speaker_enable
    pin:
      pi4ioe5v6408: pi4ioe5v6408_hub
      number: 0
      mode:
        output: true
    icon: "mdi:volume-high"
    restore_mode: ALWAYS_ON

  - platform: template
    name: "Mute Microphone"
    id: mute
    icon: "mdi:microphone-off"
    optimistic: true
    restore_mode: RESTORE_DEFAULT_OFF
    entity_category: config

    on_turn_off:
      - microphone.unmute:
      - lambda: |-
          id(voice_assistant_phase) =
            ${voice_assist_idle_phase_id};
      - script.execute: draw_display

    on_turn_on:
      - microphone.mute:
      - lambda: |-
          id(voice_assistant_phase) =
            ${voice_assist_muted_phase_id};
      - script.execute: draw_display

  - platform: template
    id: timer_ringing
    optimistic: true
    internal: true
    restore_mode: ALWAYS_OFF

    on_turn_off:
      - lambda: |-
          id(echo_base_player)
            ->make_call()
            .set_command(
              media_player::MediaPlayerCommand::
                MEDIA_PLAYER_COMMAND_REPEAT_OFF
            )
            .set_announcement(true)
            .perform();

          id(echo_base_player)->set_playlist_delay_ms(
            speaker::AudioPipelineType::ANNOUNCEMENT,
            0
          );

      - media_player.stop:
          id: echo_base_player
          announcement: true

      - script.execute: start_wake_word

    on_turn_on:
      - script.execute: stop_wake_word

      - lambda: |-
          id(echo_base_player)
            ->make_call()
            .set_command(
              media_player::MediaPlayerCommand::
                MEDIA_PLAYER_COMMAND_REPEAT_ONE
            )
            .set_announcement(true)
            .perform();

          id(echo_base_player)->set_playlist_delay_ms(
            speaker::AudioPipelineType::ANNOUNCEMENT,
            1000
          );

      - script.execute:
          id: play_sound
          priority: true
          sound_file: !lambda return id(timer_finished_sound);

      - delay: 15min
      - switch.turn_off: timer_ringing

select:
  - platform: template
    entity_category: config
    name: "Wake word engine location"
    id: wake_word_engine_location
    icon: "mdi:account-voice"
    optimistic: true
    restore_value: true

    options:
      - In Home Assistant
      - On device

    initial_option: On device

    on_value:
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: return !id(init_in_progress);
          then:
            - wait_until:
                lambda: |-
                  return
                    id(voice_assistant_phase) ==
                      ${voice_assist_muted_phase_id} ||
                    id(voice_assistant_phase) ==
                      ${voice_assist_idle_phase_id};

            - if:
                condition:
                  lambda: return x == "In Home Assistant";
                then:
                  - micro_wake_word.stop:
                  - delay: 500ms

                  - if:
                      condition:
                        switch.is_off: mute
                      then:
                        - lambda: id(va).set_use_wake_word(true);
                        - voice_assistant.start_continuous:

            - if:
                condition:
                  lambda: return x == "On device";
                then:
                  - lambda: id(va).set_use_wake_word(false);
                  - voice_assistant.stop:
                  - delay: 500ms

                  - if:
                      condition:
                        switch.is_off: mute
                      then:
                        - micro_wake_word.start:

  - platform: template
    name: "Wake word sensitivity"
    id: wake_word_sensitivity
    optimistic: true
    initial_option: Slightly sensitive
    restore_value: true
    entity_category: config

    options:
      - Slightly sensitive
      - Moderately sensitive
      - Very sensitive

    on_value:
      - lambda: |-
          if (x == "Slightly sensitive") {
            id(okay_nabu).set_probability_cutoff(217);
            id(hey_jarvis).set_probability_cutoff(247);
            id(hey_mycroft).set_probability_cutoff(253);
          } else if (x == "Moderately sensitive") {
            id(okay_nabu).set_probability_cutoff(176);
            id(hey_jarvis).set_probability_cutoff(235);
            id(hey_mycroft).set_probability_cutoff(242);
          } else if (x == "Very sensitive") {
            id(okay_nabu).set_probability_cutoff(143);
            id(hey_jarvis).set_probability_cutoff(212);
            id(hey_mycroft).set_probability_cutoff(237);
          }

micro_wake_word:
  id: mww
  microphone: i2s_mic

  models:
    - model: okay_nabu
      id: okay_nabu

    - model: hey_jarvis
      id: hey_jarvis

    - model: hey_mycroft
      id: hey_mycroft

    - model: ${stop_model_file}
      id: stop
      internal: true

  vad:

  on_wake_word_detected:
    - script.execute:
        id: play_sound
        priority: true
        sound_file: !lambda return id(wake_word_triggered_sound);

    - wait_until:
        condition:
          media_player.is_announcing: echo_base_player
        timeout: 500ms

    - wait_until:
        condition:
          and:
            - not:
                media_player.is_announcing: echo_base_player
            - not:
                speaker.is_playing: i2s_speaker
        timeout: 10s

    - voice_assistant.start:
        wake_word: !lambda return wake_word;

voice_assistant:
  id: va
  microphone: i2s_mic
  media_player: echo_base_player
  micro_wake_word: mww
  noise_suppression_level: 2
  auto_gain: 31dBFS
  volume_multiplier: 2.0

  on_listening:
    - lambda: |-
        id(voice_assistant_phase) =
          ${voice_assist_listening_phase_id};
    - script.execute: draw_display

  on_stt_vad_end:
    - lambda: |-
        id(voice_assistant_phase) =
          ${voice_assist_thinking_phase_id};
    - script.execute: draw_display

  on_tts_start:
    - lambda: |-
        id(voice_assistant_phase) =
          ${voice_assist_replying_phase_id};
    - script.execute: draw_display

  on_end:
    - wait_until:
        condition:
          media_player.is_announcing: echo_base_player
        timeout: 500ms

    - wait_until:
        condition:
          and:
            - not:
                media_player.is_announcing: echo_base_player
            - not:
                speaker.is_playing: i2s_speaker
        timeout: 30s

    - if:
        condition:
          lambda: |-
            return id(wake_word_engine_location).current_option() ==
                   "On device";
        then:
          - lambda: id(va).set_use_wake_word(false);
          - micro_wake_word.start:

    - script.execute: set_idle_or_mute_phase
    - script.execute: draw_display

  on_error:
    - if:
        condition:
          and:
            - lambda: return !id(init_in_progress);
            - lambda: return code != "duplicate_wake_up_detected";
            - lambda: return code != "stt-no-text-recognized";
        then:
          - lambda: |-
              id(voice_assistant_phase) =
                ${voice_assist_error_phase_id};
          - script.execute: draw_display
          - delay: 1s
          - script.execute: set_idle_or_mute_phase
          - script.execute: draw_display

    - if:
        condition:
          lambda: return code == "cloud-auth-failed";
        then:
          - script.execute:
              id: play_sound
              priority: true
              sound_file: !lambda return id(error_cloud_expired);
          - script.execute: draw_display

  on_client_connected:
    - lambda: id(init_in_progress) = false;
    - script.execute: start_wake_word
    - script.execute: set_idle_or_mute_phase
    - script.execute: draw_display

  on_client_disconnected:
    - script.execute: stop_wake_word
    - lambda: |-
        id(voice_assistant_phase) =
          ${voice_assist_not_ready_phase_id};
    - script.execute: draw_display

  on_timer_finished:
    - switch.turn_on: timer_ringing

    - wait_until:
        condition:
          media_player.is_announcing: echo_base_player
        timeout: 5s

    - lambda: |-
        id(voice_assistant_phase) =
          ${voice_assist_timer_finished_phase_id};
    - script.execute: draw_display

globals:
  - id: init_in_progress
    type: bool
    restore_value: false
    initial_value: "true"

  - id: voice_assistant_phase
    type: int
    restore_value: false
    initial_value: ${voice_assist_not_ready_phase_id}

lp5562:
  id: lp5562_led
  i2c_id: bsp_bus
  use_internal_clk: true
  white_current: 17.5

output:
  - platform: lp5562
    id: lp5562_white_channel
    lp5562_id: lp5562_led
    channel: white

light:
  - platform: monochromatic
    name: "LCD Backlight"
    id: lcd_backlight
    output: lp5562_white_channel
    icon: "mdi:television"
    restore_mode: ALWAYS_ON

time:
  - platform: sntp
    id: sntp_time
    servers:
      - time.google.com
    timezone: "America/Fortaleza"
    on_time_sync:
      - script.execute: draw_display

font:
  - file: "gfonts://Roboto"
    id: time_font
    size: 18

  - file: "gfonts://Roboto"
    id: status_font
    size: 16

  - file: "gfonts://Roboto@700"
    id: time_bold_font
    size: 23

  - file: "gfonts://Roboto@400"
    id: date_font
    size: 14

  - file: "gfonts://Roboto@700"
    id: pronto_font
    size: 19

  - file: ${mdi_webfont_file}
    id: mdi_icon_128
    size: 128
    bpp: 4
    glyphs:
      - "\U000F036D" # mdi:mic-mute

color:
  - id: idle_color
    hex: ${idle_illustration_background_color}

  - id: listening_color
    hex: ${listening_illustration_background_color}

  - id: thinking_color
    hex: ${thinking_illustration_background_color}

  - id: replying_color
    hex: ${replying_illustration_background_color}

  - id: loading_color
    hex: ${loading_illustration_background_color}

  - id: error_color
    hex: ${error_illustration_background_color}

  - id: text_yellow
    red: 50%
    green: 50%
    blue: 0%

  - id: text_cyan
    red: 0%
    green: 50%
    blue: 50%

  - id: text_green
    red: 0%
    green: 100%
    blue: 0%

  - id: text_red
    red: 100%
    green: 0%
    blue: 0%

  - id: light_gray
    hex: "CCCCCC"

  - id: text_blue
    hex: "2196F3"

  - id: color_white
    hex: "FFFFFF"

  - id: color_black
    hex: "000000"

image:
  - file: ${error_illustration_file}
    id: casita_error
    resize: 160x120
    type: RGB
    transparency: alpha_channel

  - file: ${idle_illustration_file}
    id: casita_idle
    resize: 160x120
    type: RGB
    transparency: alpha_channel

  - file: ${listening_illustration_file}
    id: casita_listening
    resize: 160x120
    type: RGB
    transparency: alpha_channel

  - file: ${thinking_illustration_file}
    id: casita_thinking
    resize: 160x120
    type: RGB
    transparency: alpha_channel

  - file: ${replying_illustration_file}
    id: casita_replying
    resize: 160x120
    type: RGB
    transparency: alpha_channel

  - file: ${loading_illustration_file}
    id: casita_initializing
    resize: 160x120
    type: RGB
    transparency: alpha_channel

  - file: ${error_no_wifi_illustration_file}
    id: error_no_wifi
    resize: 160x120
    type: RGB
    transparency: alpha_channel

  - file: ${error_no_ha_illustration_file}
    id: error_no_ha
    resize: 160x120
    type: RGB
    transparency: alpha_channel

display:
  - platform: mipi_spi
    id: atoms3r_lcd
    model: M5STACK-ATOMS3R-GC9107
    spi_id: spi_bus
    rotation: 180°
    update_interval: never

    pages:
      - id: idle_page
        lambda: |-
          it.fill(id(idle_color));
          it.image(64, 64, id(casita_idle), ImageAlign::CENTER);
          it.strftime(64, 6, id(time_bold_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%H:%M", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.strftime(64, 32, id(date_font), id(light_gray), TextAlign::CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.printf(64, 96, id(pronto_font), id(text_blue), TextAlign::CENTER, "PRONTO!");

      - id: listening_page
        lambda: |-
          it.fill(id(listening_color));
          it.image(64, 64, id(casita_listening), ImageAlign::CENTER);
          it.strftime(64, 8, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%H:%M", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.strftime(64, 26, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.printf(64, 92, id(status_font), id(text_yellow), TextAlign::CENTER, "Ouvindo...");

      - id: thinking_page
        lambda: |-
          it.fill(id(thinking_color));
          it.image(64, 64, id(casita_thinking), ImageAlign::CENTER);
          it.strftime(64, 8, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%H:%M", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.strftime(64, 26, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.printf(64, 92, id(status_font), id(text_cyan), TextAlign::CENTER, "Enviando p/ HA...");

      - id: replying_page
        lambda: |-
          it.fill(id(replying_color));
          it.image(64, 64, id(casita_replying), ImageAlign::CENTER);
          it.strftime(64, 8, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%H:%M", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.strftime(64, 26, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.printf(64, 92, id(status_font), id(text_green), TextAlign::CENTER, "Respondendo...");

      - id: error_page
        lambda: |-
          it.fill(id(error_color));
          it.image(64, 64, id(casita_error), ImageAlign::CENTER);
          it.strftime(64, 8, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%H:%M", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.strftime(64, 26, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.printf(64, 92, id(status_font), id(text_red), TextAlign::CENTER, "Erro");

      - id: no_ha_page
        lambda: |-
          it.fill(id(error_color));
          it.image(64, 64, id(error_no_ha), ImageAlign::CENTER);
          it.strftime(64, 8, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%H:%M", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.strftime(64, 26, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.printf(64, 100, id(status_font), id(text_red), TextAlign::CENTER, "Sem conexão HA");

      - id: no_wifi_page
        lambda: |-
          it.fill(id(error_color));
          it.image(64, 64, id(error_no_wifi), ImageAlign::CENTER);
          it.strftime(64, 8, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%H:%M", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.strftime(64, 26, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.printf(64, 100, id(status_font), id(text_red), TextAlign::CENTER, "Sem Wi-Fi");

      - id: initializing_page
        lambda: |-
          it.fill(id(loading_color));
          it.image(64, 64, id(casita_initializing), ImageAlign::CENTER);
          it.strftime(64, 8, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%H:%M", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.strftime(64, 26, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.printf(64, 92, id(status_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "Inicializando...");

      - id: muted_page
        lambda: |-
          it.fill(id(color_black));
          it.image(64, 64, id(casita_idle), ImageAlign::CENTER);
          it.strftime(64, 8, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%H:%M", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.strftime(64, 26, id(time_font), id(color_white), TextAlign::CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", id(sntp_time).now());
          it.printf(64, 92, id(status_font), id(text_red), TextAlign::CENTER, "Microfone mudo");

script:
  - id: start_wake_word
    mode: restart
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            and:
              - switch.is_off: mute
              - not:
                  voice_assistant.is_running:
              - lambda: |-
                  return
                    id(wake_word_engine_location).current_option() ==
                    "On device";
          then:
            - lambda: id(va).set_use_wake_word(false);
            - micro_wake_word.start:

      - if:
          condition:
            and:
              - switch.is_off: mute
              - not:
                  voice_assistant.is_running:
              - lambda: |-
                  return
                    id(wake_word_engine_location).current_option() ==
                    "In Home Assistant";
          then:
            - lambda: id(va).set_use_wake_word(true);
            - voice_assistant.start_continuous:

  - id: stop_wake_word
    mode: restart
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: |-
              return
                id(wake_word_engine_location).current_option() ==
                "In Home Assistant";
          then:
            - lambda: id(va).set_use_wake_word(false);
            - voice_assistant.stop:

      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: |-
              return
                id(wake_word_engine_location).current_option() ==
                "On device";
          then:
            - micro_wake_word.stop:

  - id: set_idle_or_mute_phase
    mode: restart
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            switch.is_off: mute
          then:
            - lambda: |-
                id(voice_assistant_phase) =
                  ${voice_assist_idle_phase_id};
          else:
            - lambda: |-
                id(voice_assistant_phase) =
                  ${voice_assist_muted_phase_id};

  - id: play_sound
    mode: restart
    parameters:
      priority: bool
      sound_file: "audio::AudioFile*"
    then:
      - lambda: |-
          if (priority) {
            id(echo_base_player)
              ->make_call()
              .set_command(
                media_player::MediaPlayerCommand::
                  MEDIA_PLAYER_COMMAND_STOP
              )
              .set_announcement(true)
              .perform();
          }

          if (
            id(echo_base_player).state !=
              media_player::MediaPlayerState::
                MEDIA_PLAYER_STATE_ANNOUNCING ||
            priority
          ) {
            id(echo_base_player)->play_file(
              sound_file,
              true,
              false
            );
          }

  - id: draw_display
    mode: restart
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: return !id(init_in_progress);
          then:
            - if:
                condition:
                  wifi.connected:
                then:
                  - if:
                      condition:
                        api.connected:
                      then:
                        - lambda: |-
                            switch (id(voice_assistant_phase)) {
                              case ${voice_assist_listening_phase_id}:
                                id(atoms3r_lcd).show_page(listening_page);
                                break;
                              case ${voice_assist_thinking_phase_id}:
                                id(atoms3r_lcd).show_page(thinking_page);
                                break;
                              case ${voice_assist_replying_phase_id}:
                                id(atoms3r_lcd).show_page(replying_page);
                                break;
                              case ${voice_assist_error_phase_id}:
                                id(atoms3r_lcd).show_page(error_page);
                                break;
                              case ${voice_assist_muted_phase_id}:
                                id(atoms3r_lcd).show_page(muted_page);
                                break;
                              case ${voice_assist_not_ready_phase_id}:
                                id(atoms3r_lcd).show_page(no_ha_page);
                                break;
                              default:
                                id(atoms3r_lcd).show_page(idle_page);
                                break;
                            }
                            id(atoms3r_lcd).update();
                      else:
                        - display.page.show: no_ha_page
                        - component.update: atoms3r_lcd
                else:
                  - display.page.show: no_wifi_page
                  - component.update: atoms3r_lcd
          else:
            - display.page.show: initializing_page
            - component.update: atoms3r_lcd

interval:
  # Atualiza o relógio da tela sem redesenhar excessivamente
  - interval: 30s
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: |-
              return
                !id(init_in_progress) &&
                id(voice_assistant_phase) ==
                  ${voice_assist_idle_phase_id};
          then:
            - script.execute: draw_display

text_sensor:
  - platform: wifi_info
    ip_address:
      name: "IP"
    dns_address:
      name: "DNS"
    mac_address:
      name: "MAC"

Como funciona, em resumo:

  • O micro_wake_word roda os modelos localmente (okay_nabu, hey_jarvis, hey_mycroft). Ao detectar a palavra, o voice_assistant inicia e conversa com o Assist do Home Assistant.
  • A tela (mipi_spi, AtomS3R GC9107) tem uma página por fase (ocioso, ouvindo, pensando, respondendo, erro, mudo, sem Wi-Fi, sem HA); o script draw_display escolhe a página conforme o estado.
  • O botão físico: clique curto muda/desmuta o microfone; segurar 10 s faz factory reset.
  • Áudio por I²S (microfone + alto-falante com DAC es8311); componentes externos do M5Stack (lp5562 para o LED/retroiluminação e es8311).
  • Dá para escolher o motor de wake word (no dispositivo ou no HA) e a sensibilidade, além de um timer com som ao terminar.

Ative o Assist no Home Assistant, valide no ESPHome Device Builder e teste as palavras de ativação.

Exemplo pronto: leitor RFID/NFC com tela (M5Stack AtomS3R + RFID 2)#

Um leitor de RFID/NFC com telinha, feito com o M5Stack AtomS3R + unidade RFID 2 (WS1850S). Ao aproximar uma tag, ele mostra o UID na tela, conta as leituras e envia a tag ao Home Assistant (tag_scanned + um evento), onde você dispara automações — abrir a porta, ativar um cenário, identificar quem chegou.

Troque pelos seus dados antes de gravar. A chave da API e o IP fixo são exemplos; gere/ajuste os seus. Para mostrar um nome amigável da tag na tela, crie no HA um helper input_text.rfid_tag_nome (opcional). Requer ESPHome 2026.7+.

substitutions:
  name: atom-s3r-rfid
  friendly_name: "ATOM S3R RFID"

esphome:
  name: ${name}
  friendly_name: ${friendly_name}
  min_version: 2026.7.0
  platformio_options:
    board_build.flash_mode: opi

  on_boot:
    priority: -100
    then:
      - light.turn_on:
          id: lcd_backlight
          brightness: 100%
      - delay: 500ms
      - lambda: |-
          id(scan_total).publish_state(id(scan_count));
          if (!id(last_uid).empty()) {
            id(last_uid_text).publish_state(id(last_uid));
            id(uid_length).publish_state(
              (float)((id(last_uid).size() + 1) / 3)
            );
          }
      - component.update: meu_display

esp32:
  variant: esp32s3
  flash_size: 8MB
  cpu_frequency: 240MHz
  framework:
    type: esp-idf
    sdkconfig_options:
      CONFIG_ESP32S3_DEFAULT_CPU_FREQ_240: "y"
      CONFIG_ESP32S3_DATA_CACHE_64KB: "y"
      CONFIG_ESP32S3_DATA_CACHE_LINE_64B: "y"

psram:
  mode: octal
  speed: 80MHz
  enable_ecc: true

logger:
  level: DEBUG
  hardware_uart: USB_SERIAL_JTAG

api:
  encryption:
    key: !secret api_encryption_key   # gere a sua no ESPHome Builder

ota:
  - platform: esphome
    encryption:

wifi:
  ssid: !secret wifi_ssid
  password: !secret wifi_password
  manual_ip:                    # ajuste à sua rede ou remova para DHCP
    static_ip: 192.168.1.61
    gateway: 192.168.1.1
    subnet: 255.255.255.0
    dns1: 8.8.8.8
    dns2: 8.8.4.4
  power_save_mode: NONE

external_components:
  - source: github://m5stack/esphome-yaml/components@main
    components:
      - lp5562
    refresh: 1d

globals:
  - id: status_leitura
    type: bool
    restore_value: no
    initial_value: "false"

  - id: last_uid
    type: std::string
    restore_value: yes
    initial_value: '""'

  - id: scan_count
    type: int
    restore_value: yes
    initial_value: "0"

  - id: last_scan_ts
    type: time_t
    restore_value: yes
    initial_value: "0"

i2c:
  # Barramento interno: backlight LP5562
  - id: bsp_bus
    sda:
      number: GPIO45
      ignore_strapping_warning: true
    scl:
      number: GPIO0
      ignore_strapping_warning: true
    scan: true

  # Port A: RFID 2 / WS1850S
  - id: bus_grove
    sda: GPIO2
    scl: GPIO1
    scan: true

spi:
  id: spi_bus
  clk_pin: GPIO15
  mosi_pin: GPIO21

lp5562:
  id: lp5562_led
  i2c_id: bsp_bus
  use_internal_clk: true
  white_current: 17.5

output:
  - platform: lp5562
    id: lp5562_white_channel
    lp5562_id: lp5562_led
    channel: white

light:
  - platform: monochromatic
    name: "LCD Backlight"
    id: lcd_backlight
    output: lp5562_white_channel
    icon: mdi:television
    restore_mode: ALWAYS_ON

time:
  - platform: sntp
    id: sntp_time
    servers:
      - time.google.com
    timezone: "America/Fortaleza"

rc522_i2c:
  i2c_id: bus_grove
  address: 0x28
  update_interval: 0.5s

  on_tag:
    then:
      - lambda: |-
          id(last_uid) = x;
          id(scan_count) += 1;
          id(status_leitura) = true;

          auto now = id(sntp_time).now();

          if (now.is_valid()) {
            id(last_scan_ts) = now.timestamp;

            char buf[32];
            now.strftime(
              buf,
              sizeof(buf),
              "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S"
            );

            id(last_scan_text).publish_state(buf);
          }

          id(last_uid_text).publish_state(x);
          id(uid_length).publish_state(
            (float)((x.size() + 1) / 3)
          );
          id(scan_total).publish_state(id(scan_count));
          id(tag_present_bs).publish_state(true);

      - homeassistant.tag_scanned: !lambda "return x;"

      - homeassistant.event:
          event: esphome.rfid_tag_scanned
          data:
            device: ${name}
          data_template:
            uid: "{{ uid }}"
          variables:
            uid: !lambda "return x;"

      - component.update: meu_display
      - delay: 3s

      - lambda: |-
          id(status_leitura) = false;
          id(tag_present_bs).publish_state(false);

      - component.update: meu_display

  on_tag_removed:
    then:
      - lambda: |-
          id(tag_present_bs).publish_state(false);

font:
  - file: "gfonts://Roboto@700"
    id: fonte_hora
    size: 28
    glyphsets:
      - GF_Latin_Core

  - file: "gfonts://Roboto"
    id: fonte_texto
    size: 16
    glyphsets:
      - GF_Latin_Core

  - file: "gfonts://Roboto"
    id: fonte_mini
    size: 12
    glyphsets:
      - GF_Latin_Core

display:
  - platform: mipi_spi
    id: meu_display
    spi_id: spi_bus
    model: M5STACK-ATOMS3R-GC9107
    rotation: 180°
    update_interval: 1s

    lambda: |-
      it.fill(Color::BLACK);

      Color white  = Color(255, 255, 255);
      Color gray   = Color(150, 150, 150);
      Color green  = Color(0, 255, 0);
      Color yellow = Color(255, 255, 0);

      auto now = id(sntp_time).now();

      if (now.is_valid()) {
        it.strftime(64, 2, id(fonte_hora), white, TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "%H:%M", now);
        it.strftime(64, 38, id(fonte_texto), white, TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "%d/%m/%Y", now);
      } else {
        it.print(64, 2, id(fonte_hora), white, TextAlign::TOP_CENTER, "--:--");
      }

      if (id(status_leitura)) {
        it.print(64, 70, id(fonte_hora), yellow, TextAlign::CENTER, "READING!");
      } else {
        it.print(64, 70, id(fonte_hora), green, TextAlign::CENTER, "READY!");
      }

      std::string label = id(ha_tag_name).state;

      if (label.empty() || label == "unknown" || label == "unavailable") {
        label = id(last_uid);
      }

      if (!label.empty()) {
        if (label.size() > 20) {
          label = label.substr(0, 19) + "...";
        }
        it.printf(64, 110, id(fonte_mini), gray, TextAlign::CENTER, "%s", label.c_str());
      }

text_sensor:
  - platform: template
    name: "Última TAG (UID)"
    id: last_uid_text
    icon: mdi:nfc-variant
    update_interval: never

  - platform: template
    name: "Última leitura (data/hora)"
    id: last_scan_text
    icon: mdi:clock-outline
    update_interval: never

  - platform: homeassistant
    id: ha_tag_name
    entity_id: input_text.rfid_tag_nome
    internal: true

  - platform: wifi_info
    ip_address:
      name: "IP"
    dns_address:
      name: "DNS"
    mac_address:
      name: "MAC"

  - platform: version
    name: "Versão ESPHome"
    entity_category: diagnostic

sensor:
  - platform: template
    name: "Total de leituras"
    id: scan_total
    icon: mdi:counter
    accuracy_decimals: 0
    state_class: total_increasing
    update_interval: never

  - platform: template
    name: "Tamanho do UID (bytes)"
    id: uid_length
    icon: mdi:ruler
    accuracy_decimals: 0
    update_interval: never

  - platform: template
    name: "Tempo desde última leitura"
    id: time_since_scan
    icon: mdi:timer-sand
    unit_of_measurement: s
    device_class: duration
    accuracy_decimals: 0
    update_interval: 10s
    lambda: |-
      if (id(last_scan_ts) == 0) {
        return NAN;
      }

      auto now = id(sntp_time).now();

      if (!now.is_valid()) {
        return NAN;
      }

      return (float)(now.timestamp - id(last_scan_ts));

  - platform: wifi_signal
    name: "Sinal WiFi"
    update_interval: 60s
    entity_category: diagnostic

  - platform: uptime
    name: "Uptime"
    entity_category: diagnostic

binary_sensor:
  - platform: template
    name: "TAG presente"
    id: tag_present_bs
    device_class: presence

  - platform: status
    name: "Status"
    entity_category: diagnostic

button:
  - platform: template
    name: "RFID: Zerar contador"
    icon: mdi:counter
    entity_category: config
    on_press:
      - lambda: |-
          id(scan_count) = 0;
          id(scan_total).publish_state(0);

  - platform: template
    name: "RFID: Limpar última TAG"
    icon: mdi:nfc-variant-off
    entity_category: config
    on_press:
      - lambda: |-
          id(last_uid) = "";
          id(last_scan_ts) = 0;
          id(last_uid_text).publish_state("");
          id(last_scan_text).publish_state("");

      - component.update: meu_display

  - platform: restart
    name: "RFID: Reiniciar"
    entity_category: config

web_server:
  port: 80
  include_internal: true

Como funciona, em resumo:

  • O rc522_i2c lê as tags no Port A (Grove I²C). No on_tag, o UID é guardado, o contador incrementa e a tag é enviada ao HA com homeassistant.tag_scanned e um evento (esphome.rfid_tag_scanned).
  • A tela (mipi_spi, AtomS3R GC9107) mostra hora e data e o estado — READY! (ocioso) ou READING! (lendo) — além do nome/UID da última tag.
  • Sensores expõem ao HA: UID, data da última leitura, total de leituras, tamanho do UID, tempo desde a última leitura e presença de tag.
  • Botões de configuração: zerar o contador, limpar a última tag e reiniciar.

No Home Assistant, use o gatilho “Tag” (ou o evento) para criar automações. Valide no ESPHome Device Builder antes de gravar.
